user.title: New cleaning plan
user.description: You write the plan itself on the dashboard, in the cleaning plan card.

data_description.name: Shown as the device name and in the card heading.

data_description.keep_days: Ticks and problem reports of visits older than this are deleted at midnight.
data_description.supplies_todo: Optional. When the cleaner reports a supply as missing, it is added to this to-do list, for example the shopping list. Clearing it in the card does not change the list.

entry_not_loaded.message: The cleaning plan {title} is not loaded.

no_plan.message: The plan has no valid start day yet.

not_a_visit.message: {date} is not a visit date of this plan.

task_not_found.message: The plan has no task "{task}" in "{location}".

invalid_plan.message: The plan has {count} error(s). First: line {line} ({code}).

set_plan.name: Set plan
set_plan.description: Replaces the plan text. Rejected if the text has errors.

plan.name: Plan text
plan.description: The full plan text, in the same format as in the card editor.

set_task_done.name: Set task done
set_task_done.description: Ticks or unticks a task of a visit.

floor.name: Floor
floor.description: Floor name exactly as in the plan. Leave empty for locations without a floor.

location.name: Location
location.description: Location name exactly as in the plan.

task.name: Task
task.description: Task name exactly as in the plan.

done.name: Done
done.description: True ticks the task, false unticks it.

date.name: Visit date
date.description: Date of the visit. Defaults to the current visit.

get_visit.name: Get visit
get_visit.description: Returns the tasks due on a visit, grouped by location, with their tick state.

offset.name: Offset
offset.description: 0 is the current visit, 1 the one after, -1 the one before.

date.name: From date
date.description: Count from the visit on or after this date instead of today.
